title: German Crispy Fish with Tart Crust
description: A traditional German dish featuring crispy haddock in a buttery tart crust.
instructions: Season the haddock fillets with salt and black pepper.
Roll out the tart crust to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the tart crust to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Place the haddock fillets on one half of the tart crust, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the tart crust over the fish, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tart crust with the melted butter.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the crust is golden brown.
